note: Ceiling for internal/controlplane, in hand-written non-test Go lines. Build-ignored tools and generated DO-NOT-EDIT output are reported but not counted; see scripts/report-migration-progress.mjs. The bounded-context migration may only move this down. Raising it requires saying why in the same commit.
reason: Raised by 580 for the transactional PostgreSQL repository and the operator change/promotion index projection. Both are persistence for behaviour the monolith already owns, so there is no bounded context to put them in until that behaviour moves; extracting the adapter alone would put a port outside the domain it serves. Set to exactly the current count rather than a round number, so the next line of growth still has to justify itself. The previous 25497 was recorded before generated and build-ignored files were separated from hand-written source and is not comparable: on the old basis this same tree measures 26963, of which 886 is a go:build ignore generator and its DO-NOT-EDIT output.
